shared.userIdHelp: Used for watched status. Leave empty to auto-detect the admin user.

tmdb.title: Metadata APIs
tmdb.bundledDesc: Posters, ratings, original-language detection, and TVDB ID resolution work out of the box using a bundled non-commercial key. You don't need to do anything.
tmdb.userDesc: Posters, ratings, original-language detection, and TVDB ID resolution are active, using the API key you've configured below.
tmdb.optionalNote: Adding your own key below is optional — useful only if you want a dedicated rate-limit quota, or as a fallback in case the bundled key is ever rotated.
tmdb.intro: Connect to TMDB to fetch movie and TV show metadata, posters, ratings, and detect the original language for accurate audio track classification. TMDB also resolves TVDB IDs, so a separate TVDB key isn't required. Powers the poster grid view and improves foreign title handling.

plex.intro: Connect your Plex server to automatically refresh your library after each conversion, create encoding rules based on Plex labels, collections, and genres, prioritize unwatched content in the queue, and pause encoding when someone is streaming.
plex.connectHelp: Opens Plex sign-in in a popup. After you sign in we'll list your servers so you can pick which one to connect.
plex.waitingHelp: Complete the sign-in in the popup window. This page will update automatically.
plex.chooseServer: Choose which Plex server to connect
plex.noServers: No Plex servers found for this account.
plex.pathMappingHelp: Maps Docker container paths to host paths that Plex can see. Format: /container/path=/host/path. Multiple mappings separated by ;
plex.refreshAfterHelp: Trigger a partial Plex library scan after each file is converted so changes appear immediately.
plex.emptyTrashHelp: Automatically empty the Plex library trash after each conversion scan completes.
plex.prioritizeUnwatchedHelp: When adding files to the queue, unwatched content automatically gets High priority so it converts first. You're more likely to notice quality improvements on content you haven't watched yet. Requires syncing with Plex.

errors.popupBlocked: Popup blocked. Please allow popups for this site and try again.
errors.timedOut: Timed out waiting for Plex sign-in. Please try again.
errors.pinExpired: Plex sign-in PIN expired. Please try again.

jellyfin.intro: Connect your Jellyfin server to automatically refresh your library after each conversion, create encoding rules based on Jellyfin tags and genres, sync watched status for queue prioritization, and pause encoding during active streams.
jellyfin.pathMappingHelp: Maps container paths to Jellyfin paths. Format: /container=/jellyfin

emby.intro: Connect your Emby server to automatically refresh your library after each conversion, create encoding rules based on Emby tags and genres, sync watched status for queue prioritization, and pause encoding during active streams.
emby.pathMappingHelp: Maps container paths to Emby paths. Format: /container=/emby

arr.intro: After conversion, Shrinkerr can notify Sonarr/Radarr to rescan the title folder so they update their database with the new file.
arr.sonarrPathHelp: Maps container paths to Sonarr paths. e.g. /media/TV1=/TV1
arr.radarrPathHelp: Maps container paths to Radarr paths. e.g. /media/Movies=/Movies

downloaders.intro: Automatically convert downloads after NZBGet or SABnzbd completes. The script checks Sonarr/Radarr for matching tags before converting. Sonarr/Radarr connection settings are inherited from above.
downloaders.tagsHelp: Series/movies must have at least one of these tags. Press Enter to add.
downloaders.categoriesHelp: Only downloads in these categories will be processed. Works with both NZBGet and SABnzbd. Press Enter to add.
downloaders.pathMappingsHelp: Map your download client's completed folder to a path Shrinkerr can access. Make sure this path is added as a volume in your Shrinkerr docker-compose.

prereq.intro: Before the script can hand files to Shrinkerr, the Shrinkerr container has to be able to see what NZBGet/SABnzbd downloaded. That means two things must line up:
prereq.sameMount: Both containers mount the same host directory at the same internal path. Easiest: match exactly.
prereq.recreate: After changing volumes, run docker compose down && up -d to recreate the container; up -d alone won't pick up new volumes.
prereq.mediaDirs: Add NZBGet's category folders as media directories. Settings → Media directories → add e.g. /Downloads/completed/TV and /Downloads/completed/Movies. For each:
prereq.typeOther: Type = Other — keeps TMDB from matching release-name folders
prereq.uncheckScan: Uncheck Scan — webhook accepts paths under it but the file tree won't show release-name temp folders
prereq.pathMappings: Path mappings (above) only when paths differ between containers. If both mount the same host folder at the same internal path (recommended), leave path mappings empty. Only add mappings when the script's view of the file path differs from Shrinkerr's view.

install.prereq: Complete the prerequisites above (volume mounts + media dirs)
install.addTags: Add your configured tags to series in Sonarr / movies in Radarr

nzbgetInstall.download: Save settings above and click Download NZBGet Script
nzbgetInstall.enable: In NZBGet → Settings → Extension Scripts, enable Shrinkerr
nzbgetInstall.restart: Restart NZBGet or click Reload in the scripts section
nzbgetInstall.autoConfig: The script auto-configures from Shrinkerr — no extra NZBGet settings needed

sabInstall.download: Save settings above and click Download SABnzbd Script
sabInstall.categories: In SABnzbd → Config → Categories, set shrinkerr.py as the post-processing script for your TV/Movie categories
sabInstall.autoConfig: The script auto-configures from Shrinkerr — your URL and API key are baked in

troubleshoot.intro: If NZBGet/SABnzbd logs show Shrinkerr: Outside media dirs: /path/to/file.mkv, the path the script reports is not under any directory you've registered in Shrinkerr.
troubleshoot.checkPath: Check exactly what path the script reported (it's in the same log line)
troubleshoot.verify: Verify the Shrinkerr container can see that path:
troubleshoot.notThere: If the file isn't there, your two containers don't agree on where /Downloads points. Align the volume mounts (above), or add a path mapping that translates the script's view into Shrinkerr's view
troubleshoot.isThere: If the file IS there, just add it as a media directory (Type=Other, Scan=off)

downloaders.tip: Tip: Use Encoding Rules in Shrinkerr to set different conversion profiles (CQ, preset, audio codec) based on Sonarr/Radarr tags. Tag-based downloads will follow your encoding rules automatically.

rules.title: Encoding Rules
rules.intro: Apply different encoding settings based on where files are located. Match by media directory, or connect Plex to match by label, collection, or library. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom — the first match wins. Files with no matching rule use the global defaults below.
rules.introPlex: Click Sync from Plex after creating label/collection rules to build the folder lookup cache.
rules.empty: No encoding rules yet. Add a rule to apply different settings per media directory.
rules.emptyPlex: No encoding rules yet. Add a rule to apply different settings per media directory, Plex label, collection, or library.

form.name: Name
form.qsvVaapiNote: QSV/VAAPI rules use the global preset and quality from Settings → Encoding.
